name: ShiftFair
short: Resolve shift and overtime eligibility from frozen work rules and attested evidence, with bounded deterministic minute calculations.
problem: Shift disputes combine written policy, supervisor authorization, attendance evidence and capped overtime arithmetic.
solution: GenLayer validators independently evaluate authorization, attendance and sufficiency; deterministic contract rules cap requested minutes and separate provisional from final results.
outcomes: APPROVED, DENIED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED. The recorded live case finalized REVIEW_REQUIRED.
productionQualification: INCOMPLETE: public app remains RELEASE_QUALIFIED=false pending signed-browser live E2E; do not submit as a fully qualified frontend.
